parameters.name: reduction

parameters.comment: Offset of each eccentric journal, in opposite directions.
parameters.name: eccentricity

parameters.comment: Outside radius of the round M3 spacers.
parameters.name: contact_radius

parameters.comment: Running allowance at the round spacers.
parameters.name: profile_clearance

parameters.comment: Matched round spacer length. Use 16 or 20 mm for the 7 mm clamshell discs.
parameters.name: middle_length

parameters.comment: Bore radius of the printed M3 sleeves and ring.
parameters.name: spacer_bore

parameters.comment: Target radial clearance after the cycloid takes up its full eccentric orbit.
parameters.name: guide_running_gap

parameters.comment: 45-degree lead-in on both exterior faces of each cycloid.
parameters.name: guide_entry

parameters.comment: Input position. Output turns by input angle / reduction.
parameters.name: input_angle

parameters.comment: Total axial allowance between the 6810 outer-race stops. Zero is nominal contact at both ends.
parameters.name: housing_race_allowance

parameters.comment: NEMA17 body length, excluding shaft; cage follows this directly.
parameters.name: motor_depth

parameters.comment: Shaft projection from the motor face.
parameters.name: motor_shaft_length

parameters.comment: Square motor envelope, excluding connector and cable.
parameters.name: motor_body_width

parameters.comment: Space between motor rear and the 3 mm mounting flange.
parameters.name: motor_rear_gap

parameters.comment: Radius of the fixed rear cable passage. The checked layout uses 4 mm; enlarging it requires a joining-screw clearance check.
parameters.name: rear_cable_radius

parameters.comment: Continuous motor surround wall; mounting bosses retain their existing nut access.
parameters.name: motor_tube_wall

parameters.comment: Four M3 flange screws on this diameter; both motor-end 6704 inner pieces and nuts follow.
parameters.name: coupler_bolt_circle_diameter

parameters.comment: Fixed dimensional unit for expression-constrained coordinates; leave at 1 mm.
parameters.name: native_unit

parameters.expression: min(contact_radius + eccentricity + guide_running_gap, guide_pitch - shaft_race_od / 2 - seat_fit - 0.75 mm)
parameters.name: guide_track

parameters.expression: sqrt((2 * contact_radius - 2 * eccentricity + profile_clearance - 0.6 mm) / native_unit)
parameters.name: ring_wall_gap_guard

parameters.expression: sqrt((guide_track - contact_radius - eccentricity - guide_socket_fit - 0.02 mm) / native_unit)
parameters.name: guide_motion_guard

parameters.expression: sqrt((guide_pitch - guide_track - shaft_race_od / 2 - seat_fit - 0.7499999 mm) / native_unit)
parameters.name: track_guard

parameters.expression: sqrt((2 * pitch * sin(180 deg / ring_count) - 6.6 mm) / native_unit)
parameters.name: hardware_guard
